_meta.purpose: D5.3 shelter-status fixture. Shapes are `MakeShelterInput` (src/domain/shelter.ts) and are fed through the REAL makeShelter factory, so every domain invariant (occupancy ≤ capacity, FULL ⇔ occupancy == capacity) is enforced on the fixture itself — a fixture that could not exist in production is not a fixture.
_meta.provenance: HAND-SEEDED demo data. There is still no shelter source adapter in BEACON (findings F-35/F-154), which is exactly why the board takes a REQUIRED SourceMode: this fixture is consumed as MOCK and the board says so.
_meta.coverage: one OPEN with spare capacity, one FULL (occupancy == capacity), one CLOSED, and one zero-capacity OPEN (the ratio-with-no-denominator case)
